name: Question 10
problem:
Given that $g(x,y)=\sqrt{x}\,{e}^{x/y}$ and

$$
\frac{∂g}{∂x}=\frac{(2x+y){e}^{x/y}}{2y\sqrt{x}},\,\frac{∂g}{∂y}=-\frac{\sqrt{{x}^{3}}\,{e}^{x/y}}{{y}^{2}},
$$

find the set of values $(x,y)$ where all partial derivatives of $g$ exist.

Question 10
?

Given that g(x,y)=xex/y and ∂g∂x=(2x+y)ex/y2yx,∂g∂y=−x3ex/yy2, find the set of values (x,y) where all partial derivatives of g exist.

a
{(x,y):x>0,y>0}
b
{(x,y):x=0,y≠0}
c
{(x,y):x≥0,y>0}
d
{(x,y):x>0,y≠0}
e
{(x,y):x≥0,y≠0}
